Quantify observed inequality in use of offered device choices

Source: R/aci-choice-opportunities.R
aqt_aci_access_inequality.Rd

Computes Gini inequality across per-fish multi-option exercise rates within each session/tank. Each fish MUST have at least one opportunity offering >=2 alternatives; otherwise compare opportunity exposure separately rather than treating unoffered fish as non-users. If no fish selects, inequality is undefined, not falsely zero. Inequality is not evidence of dominance or animal welfare.

Usage

aqt_aci_access_inequality(choices)

Arguments

choices

aqt_aci_choice_log.

Value

Per-tank observed exercise-rate Gini and exposure balance.
